p: Lord GOD: His fear was not only lest he should not have children, but lest the promise of the blessed seed should not be accomplished in him.

whereby shall I know that I: This is a particular motion of God's Spirit, which is not lawful for all to follow, in asking signs: but was permitted for some by a peculiar motion, as to Gideon and Ezekiel.

divided them in the midst: This was the old custom in making covenants, Jer 39:18, to which God added these conditions, that Abram's posterity would be as torn in pieces, but after they would be rejoined: also that it would be assaulted, but yet delivered.
four hundred years: Counting from the birth of Isaac to their departure of Egypt: Which declares that God will allow his to be afflicted in this world.
iniquity of the Amorites is not: Though God tolerates the wicked for a time, yet his vengeance falls on them when the measure of their wickedness is full.
